name: contract-case-realpath
goal: Retain actual runner case outcomes when snapshot and runner paths resolve to the same source

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: macOS snapshot root and runner filepath can use /var and /private/var for the same tree, so valid results are discarded and strict verification reports a missing case.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: Existing configured reporter method cases use identical lexical root and file paths. Strengthen them and the existing generated-library case with real symlinked roots and outside files.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Record 2ef4b86176c1 fails both configured reporter method cases when the root is a symlink to the same source tree.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Resolve existing root and test-file paths before containment checks; retain lexical behavior for unavailable paths and reject symlink escapes.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: Both the shared reporter and generated library reporter resolve existing paths before preserving or rejecting outcome identity.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Record 5cb2810eb1a7 passes the unchanged reporter cases at afb71fb68d against red 135d6520aa09 in the same normalized environment.

steps.title: In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.
steps.evidence: Isolated mutant c7edaeba18 failed capture 7dcbbe99d553; restored 76a85d77a6 passed capture 055435367d49 with the same cases.

steps.title: Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
